decisions.headline: 《Seikyu: Let’s Go!》公布，支持最多四人合作房车旅行
decisions.summary: 据AUTOMATON报道，ACE Entertainment于9月28日公布PC（Steam）新作《Seikyu: Let’s Go!》。玩家扮演来到清宫岛旅行的妖怪，与同伴驾驶自制房车探索秘境；驾驶、导航、摄影和搭营由玩家自行分工，游戏支持最多四人合作及随距离变化的语音聊天。

decisions.headline: 《鬼武者 Way of the Sword》体验分析：如何把时代剧杀阵变为玩家选择
decisions.summary: AUTOMATON于9月27日刊出《鬼武者 Way of the Sword》体验分析，围绕人物面部演出、三船敏郎的形象以及杀阵动作的游戏化展开讨论。作者以相同对手可采用不同战法为例，分析战斗系统如何让玩家形成各自的动作叙事。本条收录的是窗口内的新分析文章，相关结论属于作者判断。

decisions.headline: 日本索尼商店开启PS5 Pro购买申请，超额申请将抽签
decisions.summary: AUTOMATON转述索尼互动娱乐9月28日公告：日本索尼商店开始接受PS5 Pro购买申请，申请截止为当地时间10月7日23:59，若申请人数超过可售数量则抽签。结果将自10月26日起陆续通知。本轮申请有资格条件，但原包正文未完整列出条件，因此不把标题中的“60小时”写成充分购买条件。

entries.headline: Seikyu: Let's Go! announced with four-player campervan co-op
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that ACE Entertainment announced Seikyu: Let's Go! for PC via Steam on September 28. Players travel around Seikyu Island as yokai in a handmade campervan, sharing driving, navigation, photography and camping duties. Co-op supports up to four players, with proximity-based voice chat.

entries.headline: The Prince of Tennis remasters reveal DLC trailers
entries.summary: Denfaminicogamer reports new DLC trailers for Konami’s two Prince of Tennis romance-game remasters. Ryoga Echizen’s DLC for Gakuensai no Oujisama is planned for October 15, while Hikaru Zaizen’s DLC for Doki Doki Survival is planned for November 13. Both contain new scenarios and newly drawn illustrations. The packet does not establish platforms for this item.

entries.headline: Former World's Edge creative director says nearly half the studio was laid off
entries.summary: PC Gamer’s September 27 report cites a post by former World's Edge creative director Adam Isgreen from his verified forum account. The packet does not establish the basis for the headline’s separate claim that the studio’s next game was canceled.

entries.headline: Onimusha: Way of the Sword analysis explores player-directed swordplay
entries.summary: AUTOMATON published an experiential analysis of Onimusha: Way of the Sword on September 27. It discusses facial performance, Toshiro Mifune’s screen presence and the translation of choreographed swordplay into player choices. The author uses different approaches to the same opponent to examine how combat creates individual action narratives. These are the author’s judgments in a newly published analysis.

entries.headline: Sony Store Japan opens PS5 Pro purchase applications
entries.summary: AUTOMATON relays Sony Interactive Entertainment’s September 28 announcement that Sony Store Japan has opened PS5 Pro purchase applications. Applications close on October 7 at 23:59 local time; a lottery applies if demand exceeds available units. Results will be sent from October 26. Eligibility conditions apply, but the packet does not capture the complete list.

entries.headline: Report says Build A Rocket Boy parent entered administration
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reported on September 28 that Build A Rocket Boy Ltd, the parent of the MindsEye developer group, entered UK administration on September 23. Administrators assess options including continued operation, a sale or asset disposal; administration does not itself establish liquidation. The future of MindsEye and EVERYWHERE remains unclear. This item preserves the procedure’s actual date while covering the report’s new industry disclosure.
